turns.customer: The seam tape inside my Squall rain jacket (order #1127) is peeling and it leaks at the shoulders now. I bought it in early June. What can I do?
turns.reply: I am sorry to hear that the seam tape on your Squall Rain Jacket is peeling. Since it has been past our initial 14-day damage window, this falls under our one-year manufacturing warranty. I have escalated this issue to our human support team (Ticket ESC-17), and a team member will follow up with you by email, usually within one business day. Thanks for understanding.
